content: {"praised":["Fun and entertaining with simple zombie survival plot.","3D effects and visuals are impressive and clean.","Action scenes are exciting and well-executed.","Blu‑ray version has great special features.","Colors pop and camera work is high quality."],"criticized":["Plot is recycled and predictable.","Storyline lacks originality and depth.","Too much focus on 3D over story.","Resembles Matrix more than Resident Evil.","Characters feel repetitive and underdeveloped."]}
